messages:
Maria P: Hey team :wave: I'm updating the new-hire onboarding checklist and can't find the editable 'Engineering Onboarding' template in Notion. I only see a view-only copy under /Company Docs/Onboarding. Where should edits go?
DevEx Bot: Hi Maria — canonical templates live in the Notion 'Company Templates' workspace: https://redwood.notion.so/Company-Templates-abc123. Open the 'Onboarding templates' page. If you need edit rights, request via the DOCS-ACCESS ticket (https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/browse/DOCS-ACCESS) or ping @docs-admins.
Sam T: For Eng-specific content we keep a working copy at Company Docs > Engineering > Onboarding (it's linked from the master). Don't overwrite the master without an owner sign-off. Minor fixes (typos/links) are okay to apply directly.
Andrew L: I can act as owner for the Eng checklist. Maria, paste the small diff here or tag me in the Notion comments and I'll review/merge into the canonical template.
Maria P: Thanks Andrew. Quick Q — what's the editable URL? The page I saw is view-only.
DevEx Bot: Editable path (request permission if needed): https://redwood.notion.so/Onboarding-Templates-xyz789 — click the purple 'Request access' button or DM @Kelly for expedited editor rights.
Kelly: Granting editor to Maria now. A couple of style notes: keep headers H2 for big sections, H3 for checklist items, and add tags in the page metadata like [team:eng] and [owner:Andrew L]. Also use a 'changelog' toggle at the bottom for small revisions.
Maria P: Got editor access, thank you :raised_hands:. I'm planning to add a 'first-week infra checklist' as a collapsible toggle. Example I want to paste in a code-style list:
```
- set up SSH keys and add to GitHub
- request org GH team access (platform/team repos)
- join Dedicated account and request GPU pool access
- register on-call pager if applicable
```
Sam T: Looks good. Suggest we keep infra steps minimal and link to detailed infra playbooks instead of duplicating. Put the detailed commands in a linked doc and keep the template checklist high-level.
Maria P: Done — added the high-level items and linked to the infra playbook. Left a comment for Andrew to review the change. Thanks all! :smile:
DevEx Bot: Edit recorded: Maria P updated 'Engineering Onboarding' template (v2.1). Access granted by Kelly. If you need a permanent docs owner change, file DOCS-OWNER update request.
